The song's music video was released on 13 September 2011, with the song being released as a digital single in Japan 10 days later.  The song features vocals from singer Lucy Taylor.  The single was produced by constant collaborator XXXChange and mixed by Sub Focus.
What My Mother Taught Me | What My Mother Taught Me is the debut EP by English singer-songwriter Laura White, who finished in eighth place on the fifth series of "The X Factor" in 2008.  The four-track EP was released in the United Kingdom on 10 November 2013.
